server/reports/final_fragrance_verification/live_catalog_99.json (checked-in snapshot, created_at values show 2026-10-09). A live PostgreSQL read was unavailable during this workbook build.
src/data/perfumeNotes.js supplies the website fallback notes, accords, descriptions and whenToWear values when the database snapshot has no value.
server/scripts/seedProducts.js. These are code-seed prices in INR, not confirmed current product_variants rows.
server/scripts/updateProductImages.js plus local file existence under public/images/perfumes/. This verifies a local mapped asset, not the image currently served by production.
src/data/localNotesMap.json and src/data/fragranceNotesData.jsx aliases, checked against files under public/images/notes/.
Accord 1 is the first/highest displayed rank, followed by the stored source order. The bar widths in the website are display styling, not measured percentages.
The numbered notes preserve the stored order within each top/middle/base group. Fragrantica often lists the pyramid as a group and does not rank note strength within each group.
Highest season and day/night are selected from the database when_to_wear values when present; otherwise from the code profile. Scores are app weighting inputs, not public consumer ratings.
Yes means the named source contained the field or a mapped local photo file was found. Blank means the checked-in source did not confirm it, so it needs review or filling.
Every product row in the 99-row database snapshot is retained, including repeated names. Use DB ID to tell repeated rows apart.
